evals.prompt: A customer just gave us a new WhatsApp number's token. Add it to the running Wappa app without restarting.
evals.expected_output: Explicit routing with an IInboxDirectorySource; builds the record with app.state.inbox_runtime.credential_service.create_active_record(inbox_ref=InboxRef.whatsapp(pnid), account_ref=PlatformAccountRef.whatsapp(waba), access_token=SecretStr(...)); stores dump_record_for_storage(record) in the Host transaction; then awaits directory.refresh_inbox(inbox_ref); subscribes the WABA (or uses WhatsAppConnector.activate); never stores the token in a cache or plaintext.
assertions: commits the record before calling refresh_inbox
uses InboxCredentialService to build the record, not hand-encryption
uses InboxRef / PlatformAccountRef, not bare ids

evals.prompt: When our CRM marks a deal won, message the customer on whichever Platform they talk to us on.
evals.expected_output: WebhookPlugin with an IWebhookProcessor that verifies the signature (HMACSignatureVerifier or the provider's scheme) and returns an ExternalEvent; an IExternalWebhookContextResolver mapping the CRM contact to the stored InboxRef and user_id; process_external_event checks self.messenger before sending with a DirectMessage built from stored DeliveryAddresses; idempotent on the provider's event id.
assertions: authenticates the provider request in parse_event
uses a context resolver to bind the Inbox, not webhook_id
checks self.messenger is bound before sending

evals.prompt: Block free-form WhatsApp sends to users who haven't written in 24 hours, for both bot replies and our operator API.
evals.expected_output: A MessengerMiddleware (handle(invocation, call_next)) registered with WappaBuilder.add_messenger_middleware; reads invocation.method_name and invocation.target; lets template methods through; returns a rejected MessageResult instead of calling call_next; notes Wappa has no built-in window guard and API sends run the same middleware.

Reads CHANGELOG and the migration guide first; lists and applies the breaks (DirectMessage targets, self.whatsapp.templates, messenger.media, new lanes, MessageResult import and message_outcome, InteractiveHeader, create_messaging_router, InboxRef arguments); runs wappa migrate cache-namespaces dry-run then --apply with workers stopped; adds no compatibility shims.
assertions: runs wappa migrate cache-namespaces with a dry run first
does not add aliases or shims for removed names

evals.prompt: How do I send a carousel of products to a WhatsApp user from my handler?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the wappa-apps skill (messaging) rather than answering from this skill's integration references.
